instruction: Treat production parity as an end-to-end source-versus-provider predicate, not the result of a green workflow. Do not cancel an in-flight authorized deployment due to harmless pushes. Let at most the latest pending reconcile proceed; compare all changes since last live SHA with current main before deciding no-deploy. If live SHA/ancestry is absent, fail closed into deploy-required. Before any success claim, check exact Netlify commit and authenticated production routes. No second executor, no bypass of branch protection or security.
